images.title: Slide the set square
images.purpose: Show a set square sliding along a ruler and drawing two upright lines that are both at 90 degrees to the ruler line.
images.composition: A long horizontal ruler across the lower half, one set square at the left and a faint copy at the right, two upright lines drawn.
exact_structure: A long horizontal rectangle (ruler) in grey (#6B7280) outline with 10 small tick marks and no numbers, its top edge is line l.
A right angled triangle (set square) in amber (#E69F00) standing on the ruler at the left, its upright edge on the left side.
A second copy of the set square at the right, dashed outline only, same size and same direction.
A grey dashed arrow pointing right between the two set squares.
Two vertical teal (#0072B2) lines rising from l, one along the upright edge of each set square position.
A small square right angle mark at the foot of each vertical line, each labelled 90°.
rejection: a set square rotated in the second position
right angle marks missing or not 90°
images.takeaway: The set square does not turn, so both lines make 90° with l and are parallel.
images.description: A set square at two positions along a ruler with two vertical lines each making 90° with line l.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Students see the same 90° at both positions, so the lines are parallel.

image_decisions.why: The slide keeps the angle the same.
